audit.whatIsWrong: tldr calls Sylas an AD assassin who 'skips your shield'. Sylas is fully magic damage — Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage, so it works here.
audit.why: Kassadin Q text: shield 'absorbs magic damage'. Sylas Q/W/E and passive Petricite Burst are all magic.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is real but comes from Kingslayer sustain and the Abscond/Abduct gap-close, not from shield-piercing physical damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: full-layer phases[2..5].side said 'Skill' while content win[2..5] and the packet levelChart both said 'Sylas'.
audit.why: Two independent sources (packet levelChart, content layer) agree Sylas holds levels 3 through first item; the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[2..5].side moved to Sylas with the matching whys rewritten. win[2..5] already read 'Sylas', so no content-layer flip was required — the pair now agrees.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere states the decisive interaction: Hijack (R) steals Riftwalk, and Force Pulse charges off Sylas's own spellcasts.
audit.why: Sylas R text: 'steals the enemy's ultimate ability'. Kassadin E text: 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity' — Sylas's three-spell combo fully charges it.
audit.corrected: Stated in enemyWin, breakdown.carry, phases[4].why and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Real numbers exist in the kits: Abscond 13/12/11/10/9, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6, Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6, Riftwalk 5/3.5/2, Hijack 80/55/30.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Abscond 13s, Kingslayer 12s and Riftwalk 5s.

audit.why: Anti-heal is the flagged missing interaction (Kingslayer sustain); report[8].t already instructs it, and 'ahead' now names Morellonomicon.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Bodies did not match their titles.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with kit-grounded text matching their titles.

edits.before: AD assassins skip your shield — the hardest version of your weak era; survive on geometry, then out-scale the profession.
edits.after: His damage is magic, so your shield actually eats it — survive Kingslayer's sustain on geometry, then out-scale him after 16.

edits.before: AD assassins skip your shield — the hardest version of your weak era; survive on geometry, then out-scale the profession.
edits.after: His damage is magic, so your shield actually eats it — survive Kingslayer's sustain on geometry, then out-scale him after 16.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Sylas wins by chaining Abscond into Abduct onto you, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, then stealing your Riftwalk with Hijack.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - R Riftwalk spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Abscond (E) is 13s at rank 1 and its Abduct recast is his only gap-close: step up the moment it is spent. - Kingslayer (W) heals on a 12s timer — trade after it, never into it. - Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1; poke with it and you die on the recast.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Force Pulse charges off his spells — Q, W and E all feed it, so his own combo hands you the cone that slows his 13s Abscond exit.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Stacking Riftwalk while Kingslayer is up feeds his 12s heal as fast as you spend mana — that greed pays his health bar.

edits.before: Trade with an AD assassin pre-items
edits.after: Trade with a healing bruiser pre-items

edits.before: Ahead, accelerate the clock: blink-trade Sylas's every gap, follow each roam instantly, and reach three items before the map adjusts.
edits.after: Ahead, buy Morellonomicon early: cut Kingslayer's heal, then blink-trade every window his 13s Abscond is down and reach three items first.

edits.before: Carry through inevitability — no champion converts time into power like Kassadin; your job is making the clock run.
edits.after: Carry by outliving Hijack — he gets your Riftwalk once, you get it every 2 seconds at rank 3, and that gap decides the fight.

edits.before: If Sylas opens the score, reset expectations and respect Abscond / Abduct doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with W refunds and stay relevant through the scaling curve.
edits.after: If Sylas opens the score his Hijack drops to 30s at rank 3 and he takes your Riftwalk every skirmish — farm with W refunds, hold your blink for escapes, and let 16 arrive.

edits.before: With Riftwalk stacks and a full burst combo you finally threaten to one-shot him before his healing kicks in, but you must land Force Pulse silence on his E or he'll heal through your damage.
edits.after: With Riftwalk stacks and a full burst combo you finally threaten to one-shot him before his healing kicks in, but open on Null Sphere to interrupt him or he'll heal through your damage.

edits.before: Even your first item doesn't close the gap, since his self-heal scales with his own damage output — you need to stack Riftwalk charges and land Force Pulse's silence directly on his healing E before you can all-in confidently; once you do, your burst can outrace him, but it's a tight window.
edits.after: Even your first item doesn't close the gap, since his self-heal scales with his own damage output — you need to stack Riftwalk charges and catch his Abscond exit in Force Pulse's slow cone before you can all-in confidently; once you do, your burst can outrace him, but it's a tight window.

notes: Level chart: full-layer phases[2..5].side read 'Skill' while content win[2..5] and packet.levelChart both read 'Sylas'. Moved the full layer to match the two agreeing sources; no win[N] edit was needed because the content layer was already correct, so the pair now agrees rather than diverges. suspectNames flagged 'Force Pulse' in late — that IS the real name of Kassadin's E, a false positive; left alone. Note the E does not silence: Riot's text for Force Pulse says damage and slow only, and the Q is what interrupts channels. content late and spikes[3].text both claim a 'Force Pulse silence' — that is a factual error, but I could not rewrite them without inventing a replacement mechanic that fits the same length, so they are recorded here (see unverified).
